p: One who sells his field to a gentile must purchase and bring
for the betterment of the world.
Even though a gentile has no … acquisition … in Eretz Yisrael to … abrogation … from … tithe … as it is stated: … “For the land is Mine”

Even though a gentile has no capability of acquisition of land in Eretz Yisrael to cause the abrogation of the sanctity of the land, thereby removing it from the obligation to tithe its produce, as it is stated: “For the land is Mine”
The sanctity of the land is Mine, … a gentile does have, … however, … acquisition … in Eretz Yisrael … to dig pits,

The sanctity of the land is Mine, and it is not abrogated when the land is sold to a gentile; a gentile does have, however, the capability of acquisition of land in Eretz Yisrael to allow him to dig pits,
